reviews.review:
Defender Patrol might be a small-scale game, but it’s absolutely fantastic. It’s a helicopter game that supports VR, and despite its simplicity, it delivers an incredibly immersive and satisfying experience.

The flight feeling is surprisingly good — smooth, responsive, and believable. The controls are intuitive, and the missions are engaging enough to make you feel like a real pilot on a rescue or patrol mission. Even though it’s a tiny indie game, the attention to detail and realism are impressive.

If you enjoy VTOL VR, you’ll definitely love Defender Patrol. It captures that same sense of freedom and hands-on piloting, but in a more compact and relaxing form. I really hope the developer keeps expanding it, because this is one of the most promising VR helicopter experiences I’ve played in a while.

Highly recommended!
reviews.developer_response:
Thanks for playing and your review !

I do want to keep expanding this project, but I decided to do that under different title as Defender patrol had been created with not much think of ever expanding size. There are many things to fix in the fundamental level to support more helicopters and new game modes.

I believe that light scout helicopters must work together with attack helicopters for their full potential, so I'll work hard on the sequel that will feature the playable attack helicopter.
